verdicts.explanation: The database password is committed in plain text in .env.
verdicts.suggested_fix: Remove the value, rotate the password, and provide it through the deployment's secret store.

verdicts.explanation: .env is part of the repository, so every clone gets the credentials it contains.
verdicts.suggested_fix: Add .env to .gitignore, git rm --cached .env, and commit a .env.example with placeholder values instead.
